doc_title: Reserve Bank of India - Complaint Management System
heading: complaints against banks, NBFCs, and digital payment system participants
text: For filing complaints against RBI Regulated Entities, please visit the Complaint Management System (CMS) portal at https://cms.rbi.org.in. The Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme provides a cost-free alternate grievance redress mechanism for deficiency in service by commercial banks, urban cooperative banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), payment system participants, and credit information companies. Complainants can lodge complaints online, upload documents, track status, and file appeals online. Contact Centre Toll Free Helpline: 14448 (available 9:30 AM to 5:15 PM, Monday to Friday, in English, Hindi, and 10 regional languages). Complaints can also be submitted physically or via email to the Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre (CRPC), Reserve Bank of India, 4th Floor, Sector 17, Chandigarh - 160017, email: crpc@rbi.org.in.

doc_title: Securities and Exchange Board of India - SCORES Portal
heading: grievances pertaining to the securities market against listed companies and intermediaries
text: SCORES (SEBI Complaint Redress System) is an online grievance redressal facilitation platform provided by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). It allows investors to lodge grievances pertaining to the securities market online against SEBI-regulated entities, such as listed companies, registered intermediaries, and Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs). Investors can register using PAN and mobile verification, lodge complaints with supporting documents, and track status online at https://scores.sebi.gov.in/. SEBI Toll-Free Investor Helpline Numbers: 1800 266 7575 and 1800 22 7575 (available all days from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, excluding declared holidays). Technical support email: scoreshelp@sebi.gov.in.

doc_title: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India - Bima Bharosa
heading: insurance policyholder grievances and claim disputes
text: Bima Bharosa is an online portal launched by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) to monitor and manage policyholder grievances against insurance companies. Policyholders facing claim rejection, delay, or service deficiency can register and track complaints online at https://bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in/. IRDAI Grievance Call Centre Toll-Free Helpline Numbers: 155255 and 1800 4254 732 (operating in 12 languages). Complaints can also be emailed to complaints@irdai.gov.in or posted to Grievance Redressal Cell, Policyholder's Protection & Grievance Redressal Department, IRDAI, Sy.No.115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Gachibowli, Hyderabad - 500032.

doc_title: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation - EPFiGMS Portal
heading: provident fund, pension, and insurance claim grievances
text: EPFiGMS (EPF i-Grievance Management System) is a customized portal of EPFO with an aim to redress grievances for services provided by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation. Grievances can be registered by PF Members, EPS Pensioners, Employers, and Others for settlement of PF, pension, transfer, or insurance claims. Complaints can be lodged and tracked online at https://epfigms.gov.in/. EPFO Multilingual Helpline: 14470 (available 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM). Toll-Free Help Desk for UAN and member services: 1800-118-005.

doc_title: Employees' State Insurance Corporation - Public Grievance Portal
heading: grievances of insured persons and beneficiaries regarding medical and cash benefits
text: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) provides public grievance redressal for insured persons, workers, and beneficiaries regarding sickness, maternity, disability, medical care, and cash benefits under the ESI Scheme. Online public grievances can be registered and tracked through CPGRAMS at https://pgportal.gov.in/ and the UMANG mobile application. ESIC Helpdesk Toll-Free Number: 1800-11-2526. ESIC Medical Helpline: 1800-11-3839.

doc_title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
heading: report online financial fraud and cybercrimes
text: This portal is an initiative of Government of India to facilitate victims/ complainants to report cyber crime complaints online. This portal caters to complaints pertaining to cyber crimes only with special focus on cyber crimes against women and children, and financial frauds such as unauthorized transactions, UPI fraud, and online scams. Victims can lodge complaints online at https://cybercrime.gov.in/. For immediate reporting of online financial fraud, citizens should dial the National Cybercrime Helpline Toll-Free Number: 1930.

doc_title: Department of Telecommunications - Sanchar Saathi Portal
heading: block lost or stolen mobile phones and report suspected fraud communication
text: Sanchar Saathi portal is a citizen-centric initiative of Department of Telecommunications to empower mobile subscribers, strengthen their security and increase awareness about citizen centric initiatives of Government. Sanchar Saathi empowers citizens to: Block Stolen/Lost Mobile (CEIR) across all telecom operators, Know Mobile Connections in Your Name (TAFCOP), and Report Suspected Fraud Communication (Chakshu) for fraudulent calls, SMS, or WhatsApp messages. Accessible online at https://sancharsaathi.gov.in/.

doc_title: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways - NextGen eChallan Portal
heading: check and pay traffic violation challans online
text: NextGen eChallan is an integrated portal provided by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Government of India, for traffic violations and enforcement. Citizens can check pending traffic challan status, view violation details, and pay fines online securely using Challan Number, Vehicle Number, or Driving License (DL) Number at https://echallan.parivahan.gov.in/.

doc_title: e-Courts Project - Virtual Courts
heading: online adjudication and fine payment for traffic and transport challans
text: Virtual Court is a concept aimed at eliminating presence of litigant or lawyer in the court and adjudication of the case online. It can be managed by Virtual Judge whose jurisdiction can be extended to entire State and working hours may be 24X7. The litigant may view the status of the case on the web portal, plead guilty, or contest, and pay the fine amount online without visiting a court. Accessible at https://vcourts.gov.in/.

doc_title: Indian Railways - RailMadad Portal
heading: railway passenger grievances, train assistance, and refunds
text: RailMadad is the unified passenger grievance redressal portal of Indian Railways for lodging complaints and seeking assistance during train journeys or at stations. Passengers can register and track grievances regarding cleanliness, catering, ticketing, refunds, medical emergency, and security at https://railmadad.indianrailways.gov.in/ or via the RailMadad mobile app. Passengers can also dial the 24x7 integrated railway helpline: 139.

doc_title: Ministry of Civil Aviation - AirSewa Portal
heading: flight complaints, airline ticket refunds, baggage issues, and airport services
text: AirSewa is an initiative by the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, to provide a single-window grievance redressal platform for air passengers. Travelers can lodge, categorize, and track grievances related to airlines (delays, flight cancellations, refund issues, lost or damaged baggage, staff behavior) and airports (cleanliness, accessibility, security). Complaints can be submitted and tracked online at https://airsewa.gov.in/ or via the AirSewa mobile application.

doc_title: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances - CPGRAMS
heading: public grievances regarding central government ministries and departments
text: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) is an online platform available to the citizens 24x7 to lodge their grievances to the public authorities on any subject related to service delivery. It is a single portal connected to all the Ministries and Departments of Government of India and States. Citizens can register complaints online, receive a unique registration number, track status, and file appeals if dissatisfied with the redressal at https://pgportal.gov.in/.

doc_title: Uttar Pradesh Government - Jansunwai (IGRS)
heading: public grievances against Uttar Pradesh state departments and services
text: Jansunwai - Integrated Grievance Redressal System (IGRS) is the unified public grievance portal of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. Citizens of Uttar Pradesh can register grievances against state government departments, track the progress of resolution, send reminders, and provide feedback at https://jansunwai.up.nic.in/ or via the Jansunwai mobile app. Citizens can also register grievances by dialing the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Helpline: 1076.

doc_title: Department of Personnel and Training - RTI Online Portal
heading: submit online RTI applications and first appeals to central public authorities
text: RTI Online is a web portal launched by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Government of India, to file RTI applications and first appeals online along with payment gateway for Central Government Ministries, Departments, and Public Authorities. Indian citizens can submit RTI requests, pay prescribed fees online via internet banking, debit/credit cards, or UPI, and track status at https://rtionline.gov.in/. Helpdesk email: helprtionline-dopt@nic.in.

doc_title: Ministry of External Affairs - Passport Seva Grievance Redressal
heading: passport application delays, issuance problems, and service grievances
text: Passport Seva, Ministry of External Affairs, provides online grievance redressal and enquiry services for passport applicants. Citizens facing delays in passport issuance, police verification problems, or issues at Passport Seva Kendras (PSK/POPSK) can lodge and track feedback or grievances online at https://www.passportindia.gov.in/. Applicants can also contact the Passport Seva National Call Centre Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-258-1800 (executives available 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM; automated IVRS available 24 hours).

doc_title: Unique Identification Authority of India - Aadhaar Grievance Redressal
heading: Aadhaar enrolment, update issues, PVC card delivery, and operator grievances
text: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) provides a dedicated grievance redressal mechanism for residents to lodge complaints regarding Aadhaar enrolment, update status, biometric authentication failures, PVC card delivery, and enrolment operator malpractice. Residents can lodge and track grievances online at https://uidai.gov.in/ or https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/. Residents can also call the Toll-Free Helpline: 1947 (available 24x7 via IVRS, and executives available Monday to Saturday 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Sunday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM) or email help@uidai.gov.in.

doc_title: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission - e-Daakhil / e-Jagriti Portal
heading: online filing of consumer disputes before District, State, and National Commissions
text: e-Daakhil (now integrated under e-Jagriti) was established under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 by the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) and Department of Consumer Affairs for electronic filing of consumer complaints before District, State, and National Consumer Commissions. Consumers and advocates can register, submit pleadings and evidence online, pay court fees digitally, and track hearings without physical presence at https://e-jagriti.gov.in/.

doc_title: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India - Food Safety Connect
heading: food adulteration, substandard food, and food business grievances
text: Food Safety Connect is the official consumer portal and mobile application of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI). It allows consumers to lodge complaints regarding contaminated or adulterated food, unhygienic restaurant conditions, misleading food packaging, and unlicensed food vendors. Complaints can be registered and tracked online at https://foodsafetyconnect.fssai.gov.in/ or via the Food Safety Connect app. Consumers can also call the FSSAI Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-11-2100.

doc_title: Ministry of Labour and Employment - e-Shram Grievance Management System
heading: unorganised workers registration, UAN card, and social security grievances
text: e-Shram Grievance Management System (GMS) is a dedicated grievance platform established by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India, for unorganised workers. Workers can register complaints, report issues with e-Shram registration, UAN cards, or scheme entitlements, and track grievance resolution online at https://gms.eshram.gov.in/. Workers can also contact the e-Shram National Helpdesk Toll-Free Helpline: 14434 or 1800-889-6811 (operational 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM daily in 10 languages).

doc_title: Uttar Pradesh Labour Department - Citizen Grievance Portal
heading: unpaid wages, labour law violations, and employment dispute complaints
text: Labour Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh provides grievance redressal mechanisms for industrial and commercial workers, employees, and unorganised labour regarding non-payment of wages, unlawful deductions, working hour violations, and dispute conciliation under labour laws. Workers can register complaints online at https://uplabour.gov.in/. Workers can also call the UP Labour Department Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-180-5160 (or landlines 0512-2295176 / 0512-2297142) or email callcenter@uplabourdeptt.com.

doc_title: Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority - UP RERA eCourts
heading: builder delays, possession defaults, and compensation complaints
text: Uttar Pradesh Real Estate Regulatory Authority (UP RERA) regulates the real estate sector and resolves disputes between home buyers and promoters under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016. Allottees can lodge complaints electronically through the UP RERA eCourts module: Form M for complaints against promoters or agents regarding project delay, possession, or agreement violations; Form N for claiming compensation before the Adjudicating Officer. Complaints are registered and tracked at https://www.up-rera.in/. UP RERA Helpline: 0522-2781440 / 0522-4697322 (Lucknow) and 0120-2977713 (Greater Noida).

doc_title: Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited - 1912 Electricity Helpline & CGRF
heading: electricity billing disputes, power outages, meter faults, and CGRF grievances
text: Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) provides 24x7 grievance redressal services for electricity consumers across Uttar Pradesh. Consumers can register complaints regarding power supply interruptions, billing discrepancies, faulty meters, new connections, and electrical hazards online at https://1912.uppcl.org/ or https://upenergy.in/. Consumers can call the 24x7 Toll-Free Electricity Helpline: 1912. For unresolved consumer grievances, consumers can approach the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF) established under UPERC regulations.

doc_title: Uttar Pradesh Police - Citizen Services & UP 112
heading: online police complaints, e-FIR, lost article reports, and emergency assistance
text: Uttar Pradesh Police Citizen Services Portal (uppolice.gov.in) and UPCOP mobile application provide online police assistance under CCTNS. Citizens can file e-FIR for theft and cyber complaints, register online complaints, report lost articles (mobile phones, documents), request tenant and employee verification, and track case progress. For immediate emergency police, fire, or medical assistance in Uttar Pradesh, citizens can dial the 24x7 Emergency Response Support System: 112. Women facing harassment can also contact Women Power Line: 1090.

doc_title: National Commission for Women - Complaint Management System
heading: complaints against deprivation of women rights, domestic violence, and harassment
text: National Commission for Women (NCW) is the statutory body mandated to investigate and examine matters relating to safeguards provided for women under the Constitution and laws. Women facing domestic violence, harassment, dowry demands, workplace exploitation, rape, or denial of rights can lodge complaints online at https://ncwapps.nic.in/. Complainants can track status online. NCW operates a 24x7 Women Helpline Toll-Free Number: 14490 (or 7827170170). Complaints can also be emailed to complaintcell-ncw@nic.in.

doc_title: Ministry of Women and Child Development - Child Helpline 1098
heading: 24x7 emergency helpline for children in need of care, protection, and rescue
text: Child Helpline 1098 is a 24x7, toll-free national emergency outreach service for children in difficult circumstances, operated under the Mission Vatsalya scheme by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India. It provides emergency response, rescue, medical aid, shelter, legal assistance, emotional support, and rehabilitation for children facing abuse, violence, trafficking, abandonment, or child labour. Integrated with ERSS 112. Toll-Free Emergency Number: 1098.

doc_title: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights - e-BaalNidan Portal
heading: online complaints regarding violation of child rights, abuse, child labour, and POCSO
text: e-BaalNidan is an online complaint management system developed by the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR), a statutory body established under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005. Any individual, parent, child, or organization can register complaints online regarding child abuse, child labour, violations under the POCSO Act 2012, Juvenile Justice Act 2015, or Right to Education (RTE) Act 2009 free of cost. Complaints can be registered, tracked, and monitored confidentially at https://ebaalnidan.nic.in/.

doc_title: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment - Elderline 14567
heading: national helpline for senior citizens, elder abuse intervention, and welfare guidance
text: Elderline (14567) is the National Helpline for Senior Citizens established by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. It is a toll-free, pan-India single-window platform operating 7 days a week from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Elderline provides senior citizens with information on healthcare, old age homes, and pension schemes; legal guidance under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act; emotional support; and field intervention for rescue and protection in cases of elder abuse, neglect, and abandonment. Toll-Free Helpline: 14567.

doc_title: National Human Rights Commission - HRCNet Portal
heading: complaints against human rights violations, custodial violence, and public servant excesses
text: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) handles complaints regarding human rights violations, custodial deaths, illegal detentions, police brutality, and abuse of power by public servants under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993. Victims or individuals acting on their behalf can file complaints free of cost online through the HRCNet portal at https://hrcnet.nic.in/ or https://nhrc.nic.in/. Complainants receive a unique diary number to track inquiry progress. NHRC Toll-Free Helpline: 14433. Email: cr.nhrc@nic.in.

doc_title: Department of Justice - Tele-Law
heading: pre-litigation legal advice and consultation from panel lawyers
text: Tele-Law is an initiative launched by the Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India, to provide pre-litigation legal advice to citizens, especially marginalized communities, through video conferencing and telephone. Citizens can connect with panel lawyers stationed at State Legal Services Authorities to seek early legal counsel on disputes before approaching courts. The service is accessible through Common Service Centres (CSCs) at the Gram Panchayat level and via the Tele-Law mobile application at https://www.tele-law.in/. Legal advice is free of cost for persons eligible under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.

doc_title: National Legal Services Authority - Lok Adalat
heading: amicable pre-litigation and pending case settlement before Lok Adalat benches
text: Lok Adalat is an alternative dispute resolution mechanism established under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, where disputes and cases pending in courts or at the pre-litigation stage are settled amicably through conciliation. Matters suitable for Lok Adalat include compoundable criminal cases, cheque bounce cases under Section 138 NI Act, bank recovery, motor accident claims, matrimonial disputes (excluding divorce), labour disputes, and utility bill disputes. Citizens can apply to their District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or State Legal Services Authority (SLSA) to list disputes before National or Regular Lok Adalats. Details at https://nalsa.gov.in/lok-adalat.

doc_title: Income Tax Department - e-Nivaran Grievance Redressal
heading: income tax return processing, delayed refunds, TDS discrepancies, and assessment grievances
text: The Income Tax Department provides the e-Nivaran grievance module on the e-Filing portal for taxpayers to register and track grievances relating to ITR processing (CPC-ITR), delayed tax refunds, rectification applications, TDS mismatches (CPC-TDS), Form 26AS/AIS, and Assessing Officer jurisdiction. Taxpayers can lodge and monitor grievances online at https://www.incometax.gov.in/. Taxpayers can also call the Income Tax e-Filing Toll-Free Helpline: 1800 103 0025 or 1800 419 0025 (available Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM).

doc_title: Goods and Services Tax Network - Grievance Redressal Portal for GST
heading: GST registration, return filing, tax payment, refund, and portal technical errors
text: The Grievance Redressal Portal for GST (Self-Service Portal) is provided by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) to enable taxpayers, GST practitioners, and businesses to report technical issues, filing errors, and grievances related to GST registration, returns, payment challans, and refund applications. Users can log tickets, upload error screenshots, and track ticket status at https://selfservice.gstsystem.in/. Users can also contact the GST Helpdesk Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-103-4786.

doc_title: Department of Posts - India Post Grievance Redressal
heading: speed post, parcel delivery delays, money orders, and post office savings bank complaints
text: India Post (Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications) provides grievance redressal mechanisms for mail, speed post, parcel tracking delays, loss of articles, money orders, and Post Office Savings Bank (POSB) accounts. Customers can register and track grievances online through the India Post CRM portal at https://www.indiapost.gov.in/. Customers can also contact India Post Customer Care Toll-Free Number: 1800 266 6868 (available 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; IVRS available 24/7).

doc_title: National Highways Authority of India - 1033 National Highway Helpline
heading: highway emergencies, road accidents, FASTag disputes, and toll plaza complaints
text: The 1033 National Highway Helpline is an emergency and grievance redressal helpline established by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and Ministry of Road Transport and Highways. It provides 24x7 toll-free emergency response for accidents, medical emergencies, vehicle breakdown, and crane assistance on National Highways across India. It also handles citizen complaints regarding FASTag non-acceptance, toll plaza overcharging, road conditions, and highway safety. Toll-Free Helpline: 1033.

doc_title: Central Vigilance Commission - Complaint Management System
heading: corruption complaints and whistle-blower disclosures against central government officials
text: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) is the apex vigilance institution of the Government of India, addressing corruption, bribery, and misconduct among public servants in Central Government ministries, departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and nationalised banks. Citizens can lodge corruption complaints online at https://www.cvc.gov.in/. CVC also acts as the designated agency under the Public Interest Disclosure and Protection of Informers (PIDPI) Resolution for confidential whistle-blower complaints submitted by post to Satarkta Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi - 110023.

doc_title: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas - 1906 LPG Emergency Helpline
heading: LPG cylinder gas leakage, fire safety emergencies, and consumer complaints
text: 1906 is the 24x7 pan-India LPG Emergency Helpline established by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India, for domestic LPG consumers of IOCL (Indane), BPCL (Bharat Gas), and HPCL (HP Gas). Consumers can immediately report gas leakages, cylinder hazards, and fire emergencies to the toll-free emergency number: 1906 (available in Hindi, English, and regional languages). For general LPG booking, delivery, or subsidy complaints, consumers can call the customer care helpline: 1800-2333-555.

doc_title: Department of Telecommunications - Public Grievance Division
heading: telecom service disputes, broadband connectivity, and mobile service provider grievances
text: The Public Grievance Division of the Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications, addresses unresolved consumer grievances regarding mobile, landline, broadband, and telecom services after escalation through service provider grievance officers. Grievances are registered and monitored online through CPGRAMS at https://pgportal.gov.in/ and through the DoT PG Wing at Mahanagar Doorsanchar Bhawan, New Delhi. Citizens can also contact the DoT Toll-Free Helpline: 1063 (or landline 011-23221166).

doc_title: Department of Consumer Affairs - National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
heading: consumer complaints against companies, defective products, and service deficiency
text: National Consumer Helpline (NCH) is a project of the Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, Government of India. It provides guidance and grievance redressal to consumers against commercial companies, e-commerce platforms, defective goods, and deficiency in service before or alongside filing before Consumer Commissions. Consumers can lodge grievances online at https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/ or call the National Consumer Helpline Toll-Free Numbers: 1915 or 1800-11-4000 (operational all days from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, except national holidays).

doc_title: National Medical Commission - Ethics and Medical Registration Board
heading: medical ethics, professional misconduct, and appeals regarding medical negligence
text: The National Medical Commission (NMC) and its Ethics and Medical Registration Board (EMRB) regulate professional conduct and medical ethics for registered medical practitioners across India. While initial complaints of medical negligence or professional misconduct must be filed with the concerned State Medical Council (SMC), appeals against state council decisions can be filed before the Ethics and Medical Registration Board of the NMC. Stakeholder grievances regarding NMC services can be filed through CPGRAMS at https://pgportal.gov.in/ or emailed to grievance@nmc.org.in. Details at https://www.nmc.org.in/.

doc_title: Ministry of Corporate Affairs - MCA21 Grievance Redressal
heading: investor complaints against companies and LLPs, dividends, and MCA portal services
text: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) provides grievance redressal mechanisms for investors, shareholders, and stakeholders under the Companies Act and Limited Liability Partnership Act. Investors can lodge formal complaints against companies and LLPs regarding non-payment of dividends, transfer of shares, debenture defaults, and corporate fraud through the MCA portal. Stakeholders can also report MCA21 portal technical and e-filing issues. Accessible online at https://www.mca.gov.in/. Corporate Seva Kendra Helpline: 0124-4832500 or Toll-Free 18002023454. Email: appl.helpdesk@mca.gov.in.
